_about: W3-2 coach guard: the SAME cases run through api/services/uct_agent/coach/guard.py (pytest) and app/src/agent/coach/guard.js (vitest). `inputs` are the texts a figure may come from. `codes` are the exact violation codes expected (empty = clean). `why` names the regex the case exists for (delete that regex and this case fails: the mutation rail).
